about.title: About Bondeega
about.subtitle: Egypt's Premier Turkish Coffee Brand
about.description: Bondeega represents the perfect fusion of traditional Turkish coffee-making heritage and modern innovation. Established in 2017 by Next Supply Trading & Distribution, we are committed to delivering exceptional coffee experiences through carefully selected Arabica beans and time-honored roasting techniques.
about.missionText: To preserve the authentic taste of Turkish coffee while making it accessible to coffee lovers across Egypt and beyond.
about.visionText: To become the leading Turkish coffee brand in the region, recognized for quality, authenticity, and innovation.
about.qualityText: Premium Arabica beans sourced from the finest origins
about.authenticityText: Traditional roasting methods passed down through generations

brewing.title: Brewing Guide
brewing.subtitle: Master the Art of Turkish Coffee
brewing.description: Follow our traditional method to create the perfect cup of Bondeega Turkish coffee.
brewing.step1Text: Use 1-2 teaspoons of finely ground Bondeega coffee per cup
brewing.step2Text: Pour cold water into your cezve (Turkish coffee pot)
brewing.step3Text: Heat on low, stirring gently until foam forms
brewing.step4Text: Pour into cup, let grounds settle, and savor
